confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: Home Assistant will be able to change this TV's overlay position, size, style, auto-hide, and auto-listen. It will not start the microphone, change the login, or install updates.

user.title: Pair your Kellie's Voice TV
user.description: On your TV, open Kellie's Voice → SETTINGS → Home Assistant → Manage TV layout from Home Assistant → Show this TV's pairing ID. Enter that TV PAIRING ID, not the separate Home Assistant device-registry ID. Manual pairing validates the ID's format but cannot contact or verify the TV. After upgrading both components, check the new 'TV alert receiver connected' diagnostic. It remains OFF and shows 'never' until that TV establishes a scoped alert connection. Turn on Home Assistant layout and TV notifications on the TV.

manual_confirm.title: Verify the TV pairing ID
manual_confirm.description: Manual pairing cannot verify that a TV is online. Compare the FULL ID below with the one currently shown by the actual TV under Kellie's Voice → SETTINGS → Home Assistant → Manage TV layout from Home Assistant → Show this TV's pairing ID: {pairing_id}. TV: {name}. To proceed, type the LAST FOUR hexadecimal characters from the ID ON YOUR TV into the field below. This can catch mistakes in the last four characters, but cannot check earlier characters or prove the TV is connected. Compare the ENTIRE ID carefully. If anything differs, go Back and correct the full ID.

v3_preview.title: Connect this TV securely from Home Assistant
v3_preview.description: Start secure TV pairing from your TV Settings. Home Assistant will discover the TV on your local network and show a matching eight-digit code. No URL or token is typed on the TV.

v3_code.title: Confirm all eight digits on the TV
v3_code.description: The code in Home Assistant is {code}. Compare all eight digits on the TV and press OK with the physical TV remote. Then continue to authenticated owner approval.

data.numbers_match: All eight digits match and I pressed TV remote OK

owner_approval.title: Approve dedicated Kellie's Voice TV login
owner_approval.description: The TV physically verified code {code}. Open the owner-only Kellie's Voice approval panel at /kellies-voice-approval in a second Home Assistant browser tab, approve the exact TV, then return here and Submit. Creating a dedicated non-admin TV account is optional but grants broad entity control; only opt in if you accept this. With no opt-in, no token is created.

data.owner_approved: I approved the matching TV in the owner panel
data.qa_instructions: Read the security and account access notice

abort.no_id: The TV did not identify itself. Turn Home Assistant layout off and on in Kellie's Voice, then try again.
abort.use_discovery: If automatic detection is available, add the discovered TV. Otherwise use manual pairing.
abort.v3_invalid_discovery: The temporary TV v3 advertisement was invalid. Restart the two-minute pairing test on the TV.
abort.v3_cancelled: The secure TV verification test was cancelled. No connection or credentials were changed.
abort.v3_code_mismatch: The eight-digit code did not match. Nothing was paired or changed.
abort.v3_expired: The secure TV session was unavailable or expired. Start a new test on the TV.
abort.v3_preview_verified: TV verified successfully using the secure v3 code and physical remote. This is verification only; your TV login has NOT been installed or changed.
abort.discovery_only: This QA integration only works when a TV debug app advertises the temporary v3 mDNS session.
abort.invalid_discovery: Invalid v3 TV discovery. Restart the temporary pairing test on your TV.
abort.cancelled: Cancelled: your current HA and TV login were not changed.
abort.expired: The temporary test expired. Start again using the TV physical remote.
abort.mismatch: Codes did not match. No pairing or login was changed.
abort.verified_no_login: SUCCESS: The physical TV and secure v3 session were verified. This is NOT a Home Assistant login. Your normal Kellie's Voice setup was not changed.
abort.owner_unavailable: The v3 QA owner registry unexpectedly failed. Check Home Assistant system logs. No login or credentials were changed.
abort.owner_expired: The two-minute owner approval window expired. Restart v3 pairing.
abort.owner_denied: Owner approval was rejected or the Home Assistant account is inactive.
abort.owner_verified_no_login: SUCCESS: v3 TV proof and actual signed-in Home Assistant owner approval are BOTH verified. This test does not log in the TV, create a token, or change existing connections.
abort.owner_setup_missing: Owner pairing UI was not initialized by Kellie's Voice. Restart Home Assistant and check the integration logs; existing TV connections are unchanged.
abort.owner_binding_rejected: The verified TV owner-claim record was rejected. Check the Home Assistant system logs for v3 QA owner binding. No credential was created.
abort.owner_receipt_verified_no_login: This TV was securely verified but the owner did not authorize a dedicated login. No credential or device entry was created. Start again to authorize login.
abort.owner_receipt_failed: The authenticated owner receipt did not complete or the TV did not cryptographically acknowledge it within the original two-minute window. Restart v3 QA. No credentials or normal TV connections were changed.
abort.owner_login_connected: Your dedicated TV login is active. Kellie's Voice has been registered with Home Assistant.
abort.owner_login_failed: The new TV login could not activate. Incomplete token enrollment will be recovered or revoked; the old connection remains unchanged.
abort.https_required: To keep the TV's renewable credentials protected, automatic login currently requires a configured Home Assistant HTTPS or Cloud URL. Pairing cannot activate over plaintext HTTP.

error.invalid_device_id: Enter the pairing ID shown on your TV.
error.invalid_name: Enter a TV name up to 64 characters.
error.pairing_suffix_mismatch: The four characters don't match the entered TV pairing ID. Recheck the ID on the TV and correct it using Back.
error.v3_unavailable: Could not contact or verify that TV over v3. Restart the test on the actual TV and retry.
error.v3_waiting_for_tv: Waiting for physical TV remote OK. Compare all eight digits on the TV before continuing.
error.unavailable: Could not contact the TV. Restart secure pairing on the TV.
error.waiting_for_tv: Waiting for the physical TV remote approval. Verify all digits and press OK on the TV.
error.owner_pending: An active Home Assistant owner must approve this exact TV. Open /kellies-voice-approval in another HA tab, click Approve, and retry.

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Show a short text announcement on one configured TV, or on every configured TV when no device id is given. This does not start the microphone.

duration_seconds.name: Duration (seconds)
duration_seconds.description: How long the message stays up, from 4 to 45 seconds.

device_id.name: TV pairing ID
device_id.description: The pairing ID shown inside Kellie's Voice TV Settings (not HA's device registry ID). An accepted action means HA published the event, not proof that TV displayed it. Leave blank to send to every configured TV.

show_camera.name: Show camera
show_camera.description: Ask a configured TV to open a Home Assistant camera entity. This does not start the microphone or send a stream URL.

entity_id.name: Camera
entity_id.description: A camera entity, such as camera.front_door.

title.name: Title
title.description: Optional snapshot heading. Set 'Show header' false to hide the title and caption.

duration_seconds.name: Duration (seconds)
duration_seconds.description: How long the popup stays up, from 4 to 45 seconds.

device_id.name: TV pairing ID
device_id.description: The pairing ID shown inside Kellie's Voice TV Settings (not HA's device registry ID). An accepted action means HA published the event, not proof that TV displayed it. Leave blank to send to every configured TV.

show_header.name: Show header
show_header.description: Default true. Set false for a headerless camera snapshot, including removal of the fixed caption.

image_fit.name: Image fit
image_fit.description: Crop fills the image area; Fit displays the entire frame with letterboxing.

refresh_seconds.name: Refresh (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: 0 disables automatic refresh (default). Use 2 to 30 seconds for in-place snapshots without popup flicker.

show_live_camera.name: Show live camera
show_live_camera.description: Show a temporary muted live HLS video overlay on a TV without interrupting audio or exposing camera URLs.

entity_id.name: Camera
entity_id.description: An HA camera with live streaming support.

duration_seconds.name: Duration (seconds)
duration_seconds.description: Muted live stream popup for 4 to 180 seconds, default 90. A short popup may close before HLS video starts; try HA's Preload camera stream option to improve startup.

device_id.name: TV pairing ID
device_id.description: The pairing ID shown inside Kellie's Voice TV Settings (not HA's device registry ID). An accepted action means HA published the event, not proof that TV displayed it. Leave blank to send to every configured TV.

show_header.name: Show header
show_header.description: Hide both the title and muted-live status line when false. Default shows them.

image_fit.name: Image fit
image_fit.description: Fit shows the complete stream/placeholder frame with letterboxing. Crop fills the image area (default).

refresh_seconds.name: Preview refresh (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: 0 disables preview updates (default); 2–30 refreshes the still image until the first real video frame appears or the popup closes.

hide_camera.name: Hide camera
hide_camera.description: Dismiss a currently visible Kellie's Voice camera snapshot or live stream on the selected TV. Does not dismiss announcements or start the microphone.

device_id.name: TV pairing ID
device_id.description: The pairing ID shown inside Kellie's Voice TV Settings (not HA's device registry ID). An accepted action means HA published the event, not proof that TV displayed it. Leave blank to send to every configured TV.

show_forecast.name: Show forecast
show_forecast.description: Fetch today's daily forecast from a Home Assistant weather entity and show it on a configured TV. This does not run on a schedule and does not start the microphone.

entity_id.name: Weather entity
entity_id.description: A weather entity with a daily forecast, such as weather.forecast_home. Leave empty to use Forecast source on the device page.

duration_seconds.name: Duration (seconds)
duration_seconds.description: How long the card stays up, from 8 to 45 seconds. The usual value is 20.

device_id.name: TV pairing ID
device_id.description: The pairing ID shown inside Kellie's Voice TV Settings (not HA's device registry ID). An accepted action means HA published the event, not proof that TV displayed it. Leave blank to send to every configured TV.

init.title: TV settings and home-screen shortcuts
init.description: Optional shortcuts appear only on the FULL-SCREEN Kellie's Voice TV home, never the floating voice overlay. Each numbered row has a label, a Home Assistant light.*, scene.* or script.* entity, and an action. Leave label and entity blank to hide a slot. A TV user must have permission to control the configured entity. Do not use these for locks, garages or security controls.
